reden: Not detected. The audit report contains multiple findings around createArt signature misuse, claim payment bugs, replay issues, and reward distribution, and it references updateArtSettings only tangentially (as a control an attacker could gain by hijacking artist). Nowhere does it identify the specific issue that updateArtSettings enforces endTime_ >= block.timestamp (EndTimeInPast check), which forces reopening of a finished mint window and enables a backrun merkleClaim to mint additional supply. The report also does not discuss the > vs >= endTime check in _validateAndUpdateClaimState or the need for a separate function to update URI/soulBounded/royalties without extending endTime. Fixes proposed in the report would not address this forced endTime extension scenario, so the vulnerabilities are different.
